Nettles (Urtica Dioica)

Remedy nettles urinary kidney anti-inflammatory allergy

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Nutritive herb rich in vitamins and minerals; supports kidney function, reduces urinary tract inflammation, and acts as a natural antihistamine.

Indications

  • kidney issues
  • urinary tract infection
  • bladder issues
  • allergies
  • fluid retention

Contraindications

  • kidney disease (consult doctor)
  • urinary obstruction

Preparations

  • leaf
  • tea
  • tincture
  • capsule

Body Systems Affected

  • renal
  • urinary
  • immune
  • circulatory

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Chronic Kidney Disease
    Progressive kidney dysfunction that can lead to kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. Often causes severe edema and electrolyte imbalances.
